key_concepts: Non-Mendelian inheritance does not follow Mendel’s segregation laws
Incomplete dominance produces an intermediate phenotype in heterozygotes
Snapdragon F1 red × white yields pink; F2 ratio is 1 red:2 pink:1 white
Codominance expresses both traits simultaneously in heterozygotes
Speckled chicken feathers show codominance of black and white alleles
ABO blood types are controlled by three alleles: IA, IB, i
Type A genotypes are IAIA or IAi; type B IBIB or IBi; type AB IAIB; type O ii
IA and IB are codominant and dominant over i
ABO blood type is an example of multiple alleles
Humans have 22 pairs of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes
Male sex chromosomes are XY; female are XX
Y-bearing sperm produces male offspring; X-bearing sperm produces female offspring
